rag.text:
Test: TC-2461 — Global - Platform connection warnings - Trello - Warning Logs after clearing Scope
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-374 Global - Platform connection warnings
Labels: manual, teamextplatform

Steps:
1. Navigate to Overview module of Root Box and create New Program Box with boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-2461 Global - Platform connection warnings - Trello - Warning Logs after clearing Scope
   Expected: A Program box with empty scope is created
2. Navigate to Box configuration for the boxName > Tasks > Scope configuration
   Data: boxName: TC-2461 Global - Platform connection warnings - Trello - Warning Logs after clearing Scope
   Expected: Only main platform is visible
3. Add new Trello connection
   Expected: Trello connection is added
4. Expand Dropdown menu of Automatic rules -> Add Board from Trello
   Expected: Verify that the task count is the same as on Trello Board
5. Go to "Trello.com" -> Log in to your Account -> Navigate to Board which was added to box scope -> Click Show Menu -> Close Board... -> Close -> Permanently Delete
   Expected: "Board not found.
This board may be private. If someone gave you this link, they may need to invite you to one of their boards or Workspaces." - Message Appears
6. Go back to BP -> Gantt module of boxName -> Wait 15 minutes -> Do e-sync -> Verify that warning log appears
   Data: boxName: TC-2461 Global - Platform connection warnings - Trello - Warning Logs after clearing Scope
   Expected: Warning log appears with folLowing message: {{Trello scope is corrupted. Error in scope for {Trello workspace}: Trello board of id: {trello board id} does not exist!}}

All tasks from removed boar are greyed out with "no access"
7. Go to Box Configuration -> Tasks -> Scope Definition tab of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-2461 Global - Platform connection warnings - Trello - Warning Logs after clearing Scope
   Expected: Box Configuration with Scope definition opens "Atlassian Cloud" pltaform and Trello Platform is visible
8. Expand Automatic Rules (In trello connection) -> Remove the Board -> Save
   Expected: The empty box scope is saved successfully
9. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-2461 Global - Platform connection warnings - Trello - Warning Logs after clearing Scope
   Expected: Tasks from removed Trello Board and warning log disappeared.
